tech_stack.architecture: Serverless GraphQL API (Lambda + API Gateway + DynamoDB)

findings.title: Immutable Audit Logging
findings.description: The application does not log the authenticated principal for write operations. The deleteProduct and upsertProduct mutations execute without recording who performed the action. The code explicitly acknowledges this gap. No CloudTrail configuration exists in the IaC, and no application-level audit logging is present.
findings.gap: No immutable, tamper-evident audit log correlating the authenticated principal (JWT sub claim) with each write operation.
findings.recommendation: Add structured audit event emission in mutation resolvers — extract sub and client_id from JWT claims and emit a JSON log entry with {principal, action, sku, timestamp} to CloudWatch Logs with retention policy.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no audit logging for write operations.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: AUTH-Q6 fires as BLOCKER because the system has write-enabled mutations (upsertProduct, deleteProduct) with no audit trail recording the authenticated principal.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Add structured audit logging in mutation resolvers extracting JWT sub and client_id claims.
blocker_remediation.target_state: Every write operation produces an immutable audit record with principal, action, resource, and timestamp in CloudWatch Logs or S3 with Object Lock.

findings.title: Identity Propagation and Delegation
findings.description: The system extracts JWT scope claims but does not extract or utilize the sub or client_id claims. No mechanism to distinguish an agent acting under its own service identity versus acting on behalf of a human user.
findings.gap: No on-behalf-of flow, no token exchange pattern, no distinction between machine-client and user-delegated JWT tokens.
findings.recommendation: Extract sub and client_id from JWT claims in the context builder. Use client_id presence to distinguish machine callers from user callers.

compensating_controls: Scope initial agent to dedicated Cognito app client with restricted scopes
Add X-On-Behalf-Of header support for delegation

findings.title: Concurrency Controls
findings.description: The upsertProduct mutation uses unconditional PutItem and deleteProduct uses unconditional UpdateItem. No optimistic locking, version fields, or conditional expressions. Concurrent writes result in last-write-wins with no conflict detection.
findings.gap: No version field, no DynamoDB ConditionExpression on writes, no ETag/If-Match support.
findings.recommendation: Add a version field to products and use DynamoDB ConditionExpression on writes for optimistic locking.

compensating_controls: Limit initial agent deployment to single instance
Scope agent to read-only operations during pilot

findings.title: Circuit Breakers and Resilience
findings.description: No circuit breaker pattern implemented. AWS SDK v3 provides default retry logic and Lambda has 30s timeout, but no circuit breaker to fast-fail during sustained DynamoDB degradation.
findings.gap: No circuit breaker library wrapping DynamoDB calls. No fallback behavior during sustained failures.
findings.recommendation: Add a circuit breaker wrapper (cockatiel or opossum) around DynamoDB calls with structured 503 response during open state.

compensating_controls: DynamoDB PAY_PER_REQUEST auto-scales reducing throttling risk
Lambda concurrency limits bound parallel request volume

findings.title: Rate Limiting and Throttling
findings.description: No rate limiting is configured at any layer. The SAM HttpApi has no throttling settings, no WAF rules, no usage plan. A runaway agent loop could invoke the endpoint at machine speed.
findings.gap: No API Gateway throttling, no WAF rate rules, no per-caller request limits.
findings.recommendation: Add ThrottlingBurstLimit and ThrottlingRateLimit to SAM HttpApi DefaultRouteSettings. Deploy WAF rate-based rule.

compensating_controls: Lambda reserved concurrency provides implicit throughput cap
Add WAF rate-based rule as quick interim fix

findings.title: Blast Radius and Transaction Limits
findings.description: No configurable limits on agent-initiated actions. Each mutation operates on a single product, but no per-session or per-caller caps on total mutations. An agent loop could modify thousands of products.
findings.gap: No max-operations-per-session, no per-caller business transaction limits.
findings.recommendation: Add per-caller mutation counter with configurable threshold (e.g., max 100 mutations per hour per caller).

compensating_controls: Single-record mutations naturally limit per-call blast radius
Rate limiting (STATE-Q5) provides partial protection against loops

findings.title: Draft/Pending State
findings.description: All mutations commit immediately. upsertProduct writes directly to DynamoDB and deleteProduct immediately sets active=false. No draft, pending, or proposed state for human review.
findings.gap: No PENDING/DRAFT status field, no two-step commit, no approval workflow.
findings.recommendation: Add status enum (draft/active/archived) to Product schema. Agent writes set status to draft; human confirms promotion to active.

compensating_controls: Soft-delete design makes deleteProduct recoverable
Agent orchestration layer can implement approval before calling API

findings.title: Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No approval gate mechanism exists. All operations execute immediately upon valid JWT with required scope. No configurable per-operation approval flags.
findings.gap: No approval API endpoints, no configurable operation-level gates.
findings.recommendation: Introduce configuration-driven approval gate via SSM Parameter Store with per-operation approval requirements.

compensating_controls: Implement approval gates at agent orchestration layer
Feature flag to disable direct mutation for agent-scoped identities

findings.title: Structured Error Responses
findings.description: Error handling uses plain throw new Error('forbidden: requires scope ...') with no custom error codes or retryable indicators. Agents cannot distinguish authorization failures from other errors without string parsing.
findings.gap: No custom error codes, no retryable boolean, no structured error classification.
findings.recommendation: Use Apollo GraphQLError with explicit codes and retryable boolean in extensions.

compensating_controls: Apollo Server built-in error formatting provides extensions.code
Agent can parse message field pattern

findings.title: Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: No evidence of separate staging or sandbox environment. SAM template is parameterized but no multi-environment config, Docker Compose, or seed data exists.
findings.gap: No staging/sandbox environment definition, no local development setup.
findings.recommendation: Create samconfig.toml with environment-specific overrides. Add docker-compose.yml with DynamoDB Local.

compensating_controls: SAM parameter-driven design supports deploying separate test stack
sam local invoke for local testing

findings.title: Temporal Metadata and Freshness
findings.description: Products have updatedAt (ISO 8601) but no createdAt, no freshness/staleness signaling, no consistency-level indication in responses.
findings.gap: No createdAt timestamp, no Cache-Control headers, no consistency signaling.
findings.recommendation: Add createdAt field. Document DynamoDB consistency behavior in schema descriptions.

compensating_controls: updatedAt provides last-modification time
DynamoDB GetItem is strongly consistent by default

findings.title: Schema Versioning and API Contracts
findings.description: GraphQL schema is documented and machine-readable but not versioned. No breaking change detection, no consumer-driven contract tests, no changelog.
findings.gap: No schema versioning strategy, no breaking change detection in CI.
findings.recommendation: Integrate graphql-inspector into CI for breaking change detection. Add schema version tagging.

compensating_controls: GraphQL introspection provides runtime schema discovery
GraphQL additive nature reduces silent breakage risk

findings.title: Distributed Tracing and Structured Logging
findings.description: X-Ray tracing is Active (SAM Globals). However, no structured logging library is implemented — no JSON formatter, no correlation ID propagation in application logs.
findings.gap: No structured logging with correlation IDs in application code. Tracing present but logging absent.
findings.recommendation: Add @aws-lambda-powertools/logger for structured JSON logs with X-Ray trace ID correlation.

compensating_controls: X-Ray provides trace-level visibility
Lambda runtime produces basic CloudWatch Logs

findings.title: Alerting on Error Rates and Latency
findings.description: No alerting configuration exists. No CloudWatch alarms for error rates, latency, or throttling on the Lambda or API Gateway.
findings.gap: No alerting thresholds configured for the agent-facing API.
findings.recommendation: Add CloudWatch alarms for Lambda error rate > 5%, p99 latency > 5s, DynamoDB throttled requests > 0.

compensating_controls: Lambda and API Gateway emit default CloudWatch metrics
X-Ray provides latency visibility

findings.title: Infrastructure Governance
findings.description: Infrastructure is defined as code (SAM template.yaml). No evidence of peer review enforcement and no drift detection configuration.
findings.gap: IaC present (1/3). No PR review enforcement (0/3). No drift detection (0/3).
findings.recommendation: Add CI pipeline with sam validate on PRs. Enable CloudFormation drift detection.

compensating_controls: SAM template in version control provides change history
CloudFormation change sets provide plan review

findings.title: CI/CD with API Contract Testing
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline configuration exists in the repository. No automated testing or breaking change detection before production.
findings.gap: No CI/CD pipeline, no contract testing, no schema validation in build.
findings.recommendation: Add CI pipeline with npm test, npm run lint, sam validate, and graphql-inspector diff.

compensating_controls: Local vitest runner allows manual pre-deployment testing
GraphQL introspection provides runtime contract discovery

findings.title: Rollback Capability
findings.description: No deployment rollback configuration. No blue/green, canary, CodeDeploy, or traffic shifting. Default all-at-once Lambda deployment.
findings.gap: No automated rollback on deployment failure.
findings.recommendation: Add AutoPublishAlias and DeploymentPreference (Canary10Percent5Minutes) to Lambda in SAM template.

compensating_controls: CloudFormation automatic stack rollback on deploy failure
Lambda versions and aliases available if configured

findings.title: API Test Coverage
findings.description: Vitest is configured as test runner but no test files exist in the repository. Zero automated test coverage for the GraphQL API.
findings.gap: No test files. No integration tests, contract tests, or unit tests.
findings.recommendation: Add vitest integration tests for resolvers: valid queries, mutations with proper/improper scopes, pagination, error responses.

compensating_controls: GraphQL schema enforcement provides implicit validation
Manual testing via GraphQL explorer

findings.title: Sensitive Data Classification
findings.description: Not a data-handling target. The system stores product catalog data (SKU, name, description, priceCents, currency, active, updatedAt). No PII, PHI, financial credentials, or regulated personal data.
findings.gap: None — data classification controls are not required for product catalog data.
findings.recommendation: No action required. If schema evolves to include customer-facing data, reassess.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Stage A resolved as No: product catalog data is not PII/PHI/financial/credential data.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: DATA-Q1 Stage A = No because the system stores only product catalog data (SKU, name, price, description) which is not regulated personal data.

findings.title: Event Emission for State Changes
findings.description: No event emission on state changes. No SNS, EventBridge, SQS, or DynamoDB Streams integration for catalog updates.
findings.gap: No event publishing for product upsert or delete operations.
findings.recommendation: Add DynamoDB Streams with EventBridge Pipes for ProductUpdated and ProductDeleted events.

findings.title: Rate Limit Documentation and Headers
findings.description: No rate limits documented, no rate limit headers returned in responses. Agents have no visibility into throttling boundaries.
findings.gap: No rate limit documentation or X-RateLimit-Remaining/Retry-After headers.
findings.recommendation: When rate limiting is implemented, configure gateway to return standard rate-limit headers and document limits in schema.

findings.title: Data Catalog / Metadata Layer
findings.description: No formal data catalog or metadata layer beyond the GraphQL schema descriptions. No Glue, DataHub, or data dictionary.
findings.gap: No centralized metadata registry for cross-service discovery.
findings.recommendation: Consider registering the GraphQL schema in an API catalog or schema registry for portfolio-level discovery.

findings.title: Business Outcome Metrics
findings.description: No custom business outcome metrics. Only infrastructure-level metrics available via default CloudWatch metrics from Lambda and API Gateway.
findings.gap: No business outcome measurement for agent-initiated catalog operations.
findings.recommendation: Add custom CloudWatch metrics for ProductsUpserted, ProductsDeleted, CatalogSize.

findings.title: Data Quality Awareness
findings.description: No data quality score, completeness metric, or profiling for the product catalog. No duplicate detection or freshness SLAs.
findings.gap: No quality monitoring for catalog data.
findings.recommendation: Add periodic quality check measuring catalog completeness (products with missing descriptions, zero prices).

evaluations.title: Documented API Interface
evaluations.reason: GraphQL interface exposed via schema/catalog.graphql behind API Gateway /graphql endpoint.

evaluations.title: Machine-Readable API Specification
evaluations.reason: GraphQL schema file (schema/catalog.graphql) is machine-readable and schema-first.

evaluations.title: Idempotent Write Operations
evaluations.reason: upsertProduct uses PutItem keyed by SKU (idempotent overwrite), deleteProduct is soft-delete (repeatable).

evaluations.title: Structured Response Format
evaluations.reason: GraphQL protocol returns typed JSON responses with data and errors fields.

evaluations.title: Asynchronous Operation Support
evaluations.reason: No long-running operations (>30s) detected. All operations are single DynamoDB calls (sub-second).

evaluations.title: Machine Identity Authentication
evaluations.reason: Cognito JWT authorizer on API Gateway supports machine identity via client_credentials OAuth2 flow.

evaluations.title: Scoped Permissions (Least Privilege)
evaluations.reason: catalog:write scope required for mutations; reads open to authenticated users. IAM scoped to single DynamoDB table.

evaluations.title: Action-Level Authorization
evaluations.reason: requireScope(ctx, 'catalog:write') enforces action-level auth on mutations vs reads.

evaluations.title: Credential Management
evaluations.reason: No hardcoded credentials. Lambda uses IAM role for DynamoDB. UserPoolId is a CloudFormation parameter.

evaluations.title: Agent Identity Suspension
evaluations.reason: Cognito supports disabling app clients and users. Disabled clients cannot obtain new tokens.

evaluations.title: Compensation and Rollback
evaluations.reason: No multi-step workflows. Each mutation is atomic (single DynamoDB operation). Soft-delete is recoverable.

evaluations.title: Queryable Current State
evaluations.reason: product(sku) and products(limit, cursor) queries expose current state in queryable form.

evaluations.title: Graceful Degradation Signaling
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered: no P0 priority specified and service not identified as critical path.

evaluations.title: Data Residency and Sovereignty
evaluations.reason: Product catalog data (SKU, name, price) is not subject to residency requirements. Not personal/regulated data.

evaluations.title: Selective Query Support
evaluations.reason: products query supports limit/cursor pagination. GraphQL field selection limits response size. product(sku) enables precise lookup.

evaluations.title: Input Validation and Schema Enforcement
evaluations.reason: GraphQL schema enforces required fields and types. Apollo Server returns structured validation errors.

evaluations.title: PII Redaction in Logs
evaluations.reason: System does not store or log PII. Product catalog data only. JWT scope extracted but not logged.

evaluations.title: Semantically Meaningful Field Names
evaluations.reason: All fields (sku, name, description, priceCents, currency, active, updatedAt) are self-descriptive.

evaluations.title: Encryption at Rest
evaluations.reason: DynamoDB table has SSESpecification SSEEnabled: true. Data encrypted with AWS managed keys.

items.summary: Resolve the audit logging BLOCKER and address critical safety risks: rate limiting, concurrency controls, and draft state for agent writes.
Address remaining safety risks (identity propagation, blast radius, approval gates) and quality improvements (observability, CI/CD, structured errors).
Complete quality hardening: test coverage, event emission, rate limit documentation, and operational metrics.

recommended_actions.action: Add immutable audit logging for write operations
recommended_actions.rationale: Only BLOCKER — must resolve before any agent deployment. Extract JWT sub/client_id and emit structured audit events to CloudWatch Logs.

recommended_actions.action: Implement API rate limiting and throttling
recommended_actions.rationale: Prevents runaway agent loops from overwhelming the service. Quick win via SAM HttpApi throttling settings.

recommended_actions.action: Add optimistic locking for concurrent write safety
recommended_actions.rationale: Prevents data corruption from concurrent agent instances writing to the same product.

recommended_actions.action: Implement draft/approval workflow for agent writes
recommended_actions.rationale: Enables human oversight of agent-initiated catalog changes before they take effect.

recommended_actions.action: Deploy CI/CD pipeline with contract testing
recommended_actions.rationale: Enables automated testing, rollback capability, and breaking change detection for agent-facing API.
